title: JuControler Create Skill registry
description: Read-only registry of Create Skill entries, one per target agent and the supervisor. Registration describes a skill; it does not install, run, or authorize it.

skills.description: Create Skill entries; agentId is unique across entries.

agentId.description: Target agent runtime, or the supervisor. Integration targets, not certified runtime support.

permissions.description: Explicit read-only permissions. Every field is fixed; there is no writable variant.

filesystem.description: May read project files; must not create, modify, or delete them.

repository.description: May read Git history and state; must not commit, push, reset, or change refs.

dispatch.description: Must not dispatch, send to, or control agents, runtimes, or managed work.

install.description: Must not install or write skills into any agent's skill directory or configuration.

verdict.description: Must not issue PASS / CHANGES / OWNER_REQUIRED; acceptance belongs to QA and independent Verification.
